parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  run_id: $json.run_id,
  workflow_code: $json.workflow_code,
  status: ($json.successCount || 0) > 0 ? 'success' : 'failed',
  finished_at: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' '),
  actual_completed_count: $json.successCount || 0,
  result_summary: ($json.successCount || 0) > 0
    ? `WF-003 completed with ${$json.successCount || 0} successful results and ${$json.failedCount || 0} failed results`
    : 'WF-003 finished with 0 successful results',
  result_summary_url: ($json.exteriorImages?.[0]?.imageUrl) || ($json.interiorImages?.[0]?.imageUrl) || null,
  result_urls: [
    ...(($json.exteriorImages || []).map(item => item.imageUrl)),
    ...(($json.interiorImages || []).map(item => item.imageUrl))
  ],
  external_task_id: $json.client_request_id || $json.submissionId,
  error_message: (($json.failedTasks || [])
    .map(task => `${task.type}#${task.index || '-'}: ${task.failMsg || task.failCode || 'failed'}`)
    .join(' | ') || null)
} }}
